topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I didn’t know, I truly didn’t. If I had, how could I have let it all unfold like this? The balloons bobbing in the air, the cake sitting untouched—each detail a silent witness to what should have been a joyous surprise. I was so caught up, believing the plan was perfect. Now, the weight of the afternoon settles around me, the quiet too heavy to bear. I wish I could unmake the moments that led here, wish I could see the undone smile, the unshed disappointment. What I wouldn’t give to turn back the clock, to mend what’s broken before it ever shatters.
